title: Rutz's Cinematic Stage
description: JRPG and visual-novel effects for any game system: natural-20 and critical-hit cut-ins with each character's portrait (PF2e reads degrees of success, other d20 systems use the natural 20); Plus adds the serious-RP stage (speakers enter and leave, expressions, dialogue box), fumble cut-ins, all four looks and the landing page. — JRPG풍 컷인·RP 무대.
